header.sector: AI infrastructure build-out (spans spenders, chips, power, materials)
header.title: Hyperscalers, chipmakers and materials mispriced after being swept into software rout

s01_bottom_line.text: Stocks that should benefit from AI (hyperscalers, chipmakers, materials) also fell in the software sell-off, and hyperscaler capex forecasts (Meta, Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft) were scorned, which the author calls indiscriminate selling.
The article advises keeping focus on large-cap leaders with strong AI ROI, plus chipmakers and commodity-related players in the AI supply chain, as most likely to benefit long term.

If AI software disruption actually requires physical build-out, the infrastructure names sold off alongside software may be mispriced, but the article does not quantify the capex volumes or earnings impact.
